meta.name: meta-ads
meta.description: Manage Meta Ads (Facebook + Instagram) — performance, ROAS, CPM, frequency, audience overlap, learning phase, creative fatigue, budgets, ad sets, campaigns, ads. Use for any mention of Meta Ads, Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads, ROAS, CPM, ad spend, or campaign settings on Meta.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Meta 广告投放与效果优化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在 Facebook 或 Instagram 上投放广告并需要管理投放效果。
copy.tagline_en: Manage Meta Ads performance and optimization
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run ads on Facebook or Instagram and need to manage campaign performance.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你分析 Meta 广告（Facebook 和 Instagram）的表现，比如 ROAS、CPM、频次、受众重叠、学习阶段、创意疲劳等，并给出优化建议。它还能执行暂停广告系列、调整预算等操作，但会先确认再执行。
howto.when: 当你提到 Meta 广告、Facebook 广告、Instagram 广告、ROAS、CPM、广告花费或广告系列设置等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看最近7天广告系列的ROAS和频次。
say.note: Claude 会拉取数据并分析表现。

say.text: 检查一下是否有广告组处于学习受限状态。
say.note: Claude 会诊断学习阶段问题并给出建议。

say.text: 暂停表现最差的广告组，并告诉我原因。
say.note: Claude 会先展示数据，确认后再执行。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) performance—ROAS, CPM, frequency, audience overlap, learning phase, creative fatigue—and provide optimization suggestions. It can also execute actions like pausing campaigns or adjusting budgets, but will confirm before acting.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Meta Ads, Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads, ROAS, CPM, ad spend, or campaign settings on Meta.

say_en.text: Show me the ROAS and frequency for the last 7 days.
say_en.note: Claude will pull data and analyze performance.

say_en.text: Check if any ad sets are in learning limited status.
say_en.note: Claude will diagnose learning phase issues and suggest fixes.

say_en.text: Pause the worst-performing ad set and explain why.
say_en.note: Claude will show evidence first, then confirm before acting.
